description: Machine-readable inventory of quality-gates audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Some but not all detection signals for the gate resolve; the skill reports this as misconfigured.
statusTaxonomy.missing: None of the detection signals for the gate resolve.
statusTaxonomy.violation: A configured gate is present but wired in a way that defeats its purpose.

layerNaming: This audit is organised by lifecycle stage rather than the four-layer baseline. Each check's layer names the stage it belongs to: pre-commit, pre-push, or continuous-integration.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns whether the tests themselves are behaviour-focused and well designed; this audit owns whether they run at each lifecycle stage.
Owns build output and bundle composition; this audit owns whether a build smoke and bundle-size budget run as gates.

checks.title: Hook runner installed
checks.expectation: Husky or Lefthook is configured for the repository.
checks.violationSignal: No .husky/ directory with hooks and no lefthook.yml or lefthook.yaml is present.

checks.title: Staged-file formatter
checks.expectation: Prettier or Biome formats staged files via lint-staged, wired into the pre-commit hook.
checks.violationSignal: No prettier or @biomejs/biome devDependency, no lint-staged block, or no matching pre-commit hook entry.

checks.title: Staged-file linter
checks.expectation: ESLint or Biome lints staged files via lint-staged, with --fix allowed, wired into the pre-commit hook.
checks.violationSignal: No eslint or @biomejs/biome devDependency, no lint-staged block invoking it, or no matching pre-commit hook entry.

checks.title: Type check on staged files
checks.expectation: tsc --noEmit or an equivalent runs against staged TypeScript files via lint-staged or a hook script.
checks.violationSignal: No typescript devDependency, no tsconfig.json, or no lint-staged or hook entry invoking tsc --noEmit.

checks.title: Commit-message lint
checks.expectation: commitlint enforces Conventional Commits on the subject line via a commit-msg hook.
checks.violationSignal: No @commitlint/cli and @commitlint/config-conventional devDependencies, no commitlint config file, or no commit-msg hook invoking commitlint.

checks.title: Secret scan on staged content
checks.expectation: gitleaks protect or detect-secrets runs against staged content before commit.
checks.violationSignal: No .gitleaks.toml, no .pre-commit-config.yaml referencing detect-secrets, or no matching pre-commit hook entry.

checks.title: Pre-push hook configured
checks.expectation: A pre-push hook exists and is wired into the hook runner.
checks.violationSignal: No .husky/pre-push and no pre-push block in lefthook.yml.

checks.title: Full type check
checks.expectation: tsc --noEmit runs over the entire project on pre-push.
checks.violationSignal: The pre-push hook does not invoke tsc --noEmit or a package.json script that does.

checks.title: Full lint
checks.expectation: The project's lint command runs the whole codebase on pre-push and fails on warnings.
checks.violationSignal: The pre-push hook does not run eslint . or the Biome equivalent with no --fix and a non-zero exit on warnings.

checks.title: Unit tests
checks.expectation: Vitest or Jest runs the unit-test suite to completion on pre-push.
checks.violationSignal: The pre-push hook does not invoke vitest run or jest --ci and no matching package.json script exists.

checks.title: Build smoke
checks.expectation: The production build command runs and exits cleanly on pre-push.
checks.violationSignal: The pre-push hook does not invoke the framework build command.

checks.title: Continuous-integration workflow file present
checks.expectation: At least one continuous-integration workflow definition exists.
checks.violationSignal: No .github/workflows/*.yml, .gitlab-ci.yml, .circleci/config.yml, or equivalent is present.

checks.title: Pre-push gates re-run on a clean checkout
checks.expectation: The workflow installs dependencies fresh and re-runs type-check, lint, unit tests, and build.
checks.violationSignal: The workflow does not contain steps invoking the same scripts as the pre-push hook.

checks.title: End-to-end tests
checks.expectation: Playwright or Cypress runs against a build of the application in continuous integration.
checks.violationSignal: No @playwright/test or cypress devDependency and no workflow step invoking playwright test or cypress run.

checks.title: Coverage threshold enforced
checks.expectation: The test runner is configured with a coverage threshold and the workflow fails when it is not met.
checks.violationSignal: No coverage thresholds in vitest.config.* or jest.config.*, or no workflow step invoking the coverage run.

checks.title: Bundle-size budget
checks.expectation: A bundle-size check runs and fails when the budget is exceeded.
checks.violationSignal: No size-limit, bundlewatch, or bundle-analyzer budget check and no workflow step running it.

checks.title: Accessibility checks
checks.expectation: Automated accessibility checks run against components or pages in continuous integration.
checks.violationSignal: No @axe-core/*, pa11y, or Storybook accessibility addon and no workflow step invoking the check.

checks.title: Dependency vulnerability scan
checks.expectation: A vulnerability scanner runs against the lockfile in continuous integration.
checks.violationSignal: No npm/pnpm/yarn audit step and no Snyk, osv-scanner, or Dependabot configuration.

checks.title: License compliance check
checks.expectation: A license check runs and enforces an allow-list or deny-list.
checks.violationSignal: No license-checker or equivalent, or no workflow step invoking it with an allow-list or deny-list.

checks.title: Lighthouse continuous integration
checks.expectation: Lighthouse CI runs against a deployed or built version of the application and asserts thresholds.
checks.violationSignal: No @lhci/cli devDependency, no lighthouserc.* configuration, or no workflow step invoking lhci autorun.
